technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with trending ADX suggest capitulation, but absence of bullish reversals, negative CMF, bearish MACD, and price below all key moving averages indicate downtrend continuation risk outweighs bounce potential.

fundamental.summary: AOS shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 64 days—insufficient smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (22/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (496+ days old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (395.2) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 64 days adds moderate event risk; macro score of -1 confirms unfavourable conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) combined with ADX trending and VIX crisis creates a capitulation setup where contrarian fear-zone conditions (22/100) could trigger a sharp bounce if support at 63.69 holds.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, negative CMF distribution, bearish MACD, Ichimoku below cloud, zero bullish momentum confirmation, no insider/institutional conviction, and unfavorable macro (-1) with earnings event risk in 64 days make this a downtrend continuation setup masquerading as oversold.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI and ADX trending suggest potential capitulation bounce, but absence of bullish confirmation (no MACD crossover, negative CMF, price below all MAs) indicates downtrend continuation risk outweighs bounce probability.
decision.primary_risk: Price breaks below support at 63.69 into fresh lows as macro headwinds (VIX crisis, unfavorable macro score -1) and earnings event risk (64 days) combine to extend downtrend rather than trigger reversal.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, and risk agents all bearish; sentiment contrarian signal isolated and unconfirmed
decision.portfolio_note: Already 3 positions in Industrials sector; adding AOS increases concentration risk without conviction support; skip to preserve capital in crisis VIX regime.
